date.source: The broadcast's own dateline names 22 September 1999.

matches.note: Empire won with his finisher, Scar Tissue, after Jones missed a leg-drop from the top rope.

matches.stipulation: Eight-man Hardcore battle royal through the arena's own parking garage, crowning the first WWWA Hardcore Champion
matches.note: An eighth entrant, the Carleton County Kid, is billed among the field but not shown in an elimination; Cryptic Saber won by pinning Razor's own stablemate after a Saber Slam onto a garbage can.

eliminations.note: Smashed into a police car's hood with the Prophecy, pinned there.
A spike powerbomb onto the concrete floor.
Whipped into the back of an armored truck, then hit with a road sign.
Thrown into a steel fence propped against a truck.
The Pearl Necklace, after Riot rubbed broken glass across Jobber's own bleeding face.
Crushed by a falling Carleton County Kid and Razor after Cryptic Saber's own ambush from an overhead beam.

evidence.note: An opening singles match and the battle royal that crowned the promotion's first Hardcore Champion, plus the Cruiserweight Championship's award by decree.

appearances.source: Announced his retirement live on the air, vacating the Cruiserweight Championship.
Awarded the vacant Cruiserweight Championship to Jarry Rice by decree and named himself special guest referee for the following week.
Accepted the Cruiserweight Championship from Chris Bane by decree.
Named on-air as the reigning World Heavyweight Champion in the roster rankings.

name: Wednesday Wargames

date.source: The broadcast's own dateline names 6 October 1999, posted in three parts the same day.

venue: Madison Square Garden, New York, New York

matches.note: Oracle shoved Chris Hopper off the top rope during a missile dropkick attempt, and Prophet rolled onto Hopper for the pin the referee, knocked out moments earlier, was just able to count.

matches.stipulation: WWWA Hardcore Championship, boiler room brawl
matches.note: Saber retained after a Saber Slam onto a garbage can, escaping through the boiler room's own third door.

matches.stipulation: WWWA Cruiserweight Championship, mask versus title
matches.note: Wrestling under a mask, Holmes won with a Shooting Star DDT after a second masked man, revealed afterward as "Too Extreme" Walker Quinn, blinded Rice with powder and pulled Razor's own ankle out from under him at ringside; Holmes unmasked as the new champion, and Quinn unmasked alongside him.

evidence.source: the promotion's own broadcast, posted in three parts
evidence.note: Three championship matches: a new Tag Team Championship, a successful Hardcore Championship defense, and a mask-versus-title Cruiserweight change.

appearances.source: Accompanied Jarry Rice to ringside and was tripped by Walker Quinn during the Cruiserweight match.
Color commentary for the broadcast, joining the announce team full-time.
